svg.title: The caches a request can be answered from, nearest first
svg.desc: A visit passes through layers of caches, and the first one that has a fresh copy answers. First the browser's router cache, which keeps page payloads for their stale time. Then a CDN, which keeps whole pages for the time in s-maxage. Then the Next.js server, with prerendered pages and the use cache store. Inside one render, React's cache and fetch memoization stop repeated calls. Only on a miss everywhere does the request reach the Trailhead API.
svg.text: Browser router cache payloads you visited or prefetched
CDN whole pages, near the visitor
Prerendered pages, use cache shared by every visitor
One render React's cache, fetch memoization
Trailhead API reached only on a miss
